$$h(z)=\lambda z+\tfrac{H}{2}z^2+\cdots,\qquad \lambda=h'(0),\; H=h''(0).$$
Then $|\lambda|\le 1$, and $p(0)=\lambda$, $p'(0)=H/2$, so by Schwarz–Pick $|H|\le 2(1-|\lambda|^2)$.

Since $f=\varphi_A^{-1}\circ h$ with $\varphi_A^{-1}(w)=\frac{w+A}{1+\bar A w}$, computing derivatives at $0$:
$$(\varphi_A^{-1})'(0)=1-|A|^2,\qquad (\varphi_A^{-1})''(0)=-2\bar A(1-|A|^2).$$
Hence
$$f'(0)=\lambda(1-|A|^2),\qquad f''(0)=(1-|A|^2)(H-2\bar A\lambda^2),$$
and
$$f''(0)+f'(0)^2=(1-|A|^2)\bigl[H+\lambda^2(1-|A|^2-2\bar A)\bigr].$$

$$|W|\le 2e^{\sqrt2-1}\bigl(1-(\sqrt2-1)^2\bigr)=2e^{\sqrt2-1}(2\sqrt2-2)=4(\sqrt2-1)e^{\sqrt2-1}\approx 2.51.$$
